illustration.description: A tall vertical measuring ruler drawn in flat vector style, with evenly spaced tick marks of alternating lengths, in a medium cornflower blue (#4A86C8) with clean rounded edges, standing upright on a plain off-white background with a faint paper grain. Minimal flat illustration style, soft even lighting, no shadows, no people, no text.

texts.font: geometric/humanist sans-serif (Open Sans / Helvetica-like), all caps, slightly letter-spaced

graphics.description: A curved, tapering orange arrow with a textured/halftone-like fill rising diagonally from the ruler's middle toward the upper right, ending in a bold triangular arrowhead pointing up-right
Three thin pale blue motion-streak lines trailing parallel to the lower-left side of the orange arrow, suggesting upward movement
